title: The universal ring of coprime monic factorizations of a monic polynomial is etale
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $m,k\ge0$ integers, $n=m+k$, and $f\in A[x]$ a polynomial whose coefficient of $x^n$ is $1$ and whose coefficients of $x^i$, $i>n$, are $0$ (monic of degree $n$; call such a polynomial of $C[x]$, for a ring $C$, *monic of degree exactly $n$*, a condition that is empty when $C=0$). Then there are an $A$-algebra $B$ and polynomials $G,H\in B[x]$, monic of degree exactly $m$ and $k$ respectively, such that: (1) $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]; (2) $f=GH$ in $B[x]$ and $G,H$ generate the unit ideal of $B[x]$; (3) for every commutative $A$-algebra $C$, the map $\varphi\mapsto(\varphi(G),\varphi(H))$ ($\varphi$ applied coefficientwise) is a bijection from the set of $A$-algebra homomorphisms $B\to C$ onto the set of pairs $(g,h)$ of polynomials in $C[x]$, monic of degree exactly $m$ and $k$, with $gh=f$ in $C[x]$ and $g,h$ generating the unit ideal of $C[x]$. (Concretely $B=(A\otimes_{\mathbf Z[a_1,\dots,a_n]}\mathbf Z[b_1,\dots,b_m,c_1,\dots,c_k])[1/\Delta]$ with $\Delta=\operatorname{Res}_x(G,H)$, Stacks Algebra Example 00UA, as in the proof of More on Algebra 0ALH.)
